what: Every step of .github/workflows/gates.yml, run on this machine in the RUNNER's shape (fresh `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, a globally installed harness at the pin package.json DECLARES, and the pinned upstream checkout the vendor gate reads). Reproduces the workflow's commands, not GitHub itself: actions/checkout, actions/setup-node and oven-sh/setup-bun are replaced by this machine's equivalents, and bun is the WORKFLOW'S PIN (1.4.0) rather than the newest, because verify-dist-fresh compares bytes.

whyThisCaseExists.failureBeforeTheFix: `bun install --frozen-lockfile` exited 1 with `lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen` + `skipped 1 workspace listed in bun.lock but not on disk: "@mpd-dsh/team-tools-plugin"`, so EVERY later step was unreachable. The stale entry was created by commit dc4ec92c, which renamed packages/mpd-team-tools-plugin to packages/mpd-team-core-plugin without regenerating bun.lock.
whyThisCaseExists.secondFailureClass: With the lockfile fixed, two aggregate members still cannot pass on a bare runner: `preset-conformance --self-test` exits 1 with `dsh is not on PATH — the case cannot verify the installed harness` (measured directly, see below), and `vendor` exits 1 with `upstream checkout not found`.

verdict.notProvedHere: GitHub itself: this ran on one Linux host, not on a runner image. The runner-specific risks left open are the two setup actions' own behaviour and the runner's network policy toward registry.npmjs.org and github.com.
